quickDeploy.title: One-Click Deploy & Optimize
quickDeploy.subtitle: One-click deployment of optimized CDN based on Cloudflare Worker or SaaS mode
quickDeploy.workerProxyDesc: Forward requests by deploying edge Workers, suitable for quick proxy and static caching without custom domains.

workerProxyPros.pro1: ✓ Super simple deployment, only one step
workerProxyPros.con2: ✗ workers.dev might be blocked in some regions
workerProxyPros.con3: ✗ Cannot use fully customized optimized DNS

quickDeploy.saasOptimizeDesc: Through deep integration with Cloudflare APIs, automatically complete fallback origin setup, custom hostname creation, verification records, and optimized CNAME/IP configuration in one click.

saasOptimizePros.pro2: ✓ CNAME / IP optimization for faster loading speed
saasOptimizePros.pro3: ✓ Origin IP is hidden for high security
saasOptimizePros.pro4: ✓ Supports up to 100 custom domains for free
saasOptimizePros.pro5: ✓ Fully automated wizard coordination, no tedious manual operations in Cloudflare dashboard
saasOptimizePros.con1: ✗ Requires two domains (Fallback Origin + Access Domain)

quickDeploy.workerStep2: 2. Configure the generated Worker name and route
quickDeploy.workerStep3: 3. Click Start Deploy to upload code and bind route
quickDeploy.sourceDomainTip: Usually your server's domain (e.g. origin.yourdomain.com) or the site you want to proxy
quickDeploy.prereqDesc1: Please ensure your Cloudflare account has Cloudflare for SaaS enabled (requires a valid payment method, completely free for Free tier).
quickDeploy.prereqDesc2: In this mode, you need to prepare two different domains: Fallback Origin Domain (e.g. fallback.abc.com) and Final Access Domain (e.g. cdn.xyz.com).
quickDeploy.stepItem1: The system will automatically create an A record pointing to origin IP under the fallback domain (with proxy enabled) and sync it as the fallback origin.
quickDeploy.stepItem2: The system will automatically create the custom hostname and add DNS verification records (TXT/CNAME) if the zone is managed on this platform.
quickDeploy.stepItem3: The system will automatically configure the optimized CNAME alias or Anycast optimized IP record in the target domain's zone in one click.
quickDeploy.fallbackDesc: The fallback origin is the default domain that Cloudflare edges request when a custom hostname is visited.
quickDeploy.fallbackSubdomainTip: Must be a subdomain of a domain already added in the current Cloudflare account, e.g. fallback.example.com
quickDeploy.hostnameDesc: The custom hostname is the final domain users use to access your website. Cloudflare will automatically request an SSL certificate for it.
quickDeploy.customHostnameTip: The domain users will actually visit, e.g., cdn.yourdomain.com
quickDeploy.dnsOptDesc: By configuring the DNS of the final domain, use a high-quality Cloudflare CNAME or Anycast optimized IPs to boost access speed.
quickDeploy.optIP: A Record IP Optimization (Specify IP Address)
quickDeploy.autoRenewDesc: Cloudflare will automatically renew the SSL certificate for {domain}. Please ensure the optimized DNS records remain routed, otherwise the certificate validation might fail.
quickDeploy.zoneNotFound: Zone not found for the domain, please ensure it has been added to the account
quickDeploy.domainNotFound: Domain not found, please make sure it is added to the account
quickDeploy.hostnameSuccessVerification: Custom hostname created successfully, DNS validation records automatically added
quickDeploy.zoneNotFoundAccess: Zone not found for the access domain, please verify it is added to Cloudflare
quickDeploy.dnsFailed: Failed to create optimized DNS record
